cases.title: Photocatalytic aerobic oxidation: matched 420 nm source
cases.protocol: Fmoc-L-methionine (3.7 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole (10 mol%) were dissolved in acetonitrile at 0.10 M. cases.objective: Design a conservative first gas-liquid photochemical flow screen using the validated 420 nm excitation window.
hard_constraints: Use only the listed inventory.
The light source must be between 410 and 430 nm.
Liquid flow must be at least 0.01 mL/min.
Report inlet/STP and pressure-corrected in-channel gas flow separately.

reactors.notes: Stage 1 is 5 mL, stage 2 is 10 mL, with an interstage mixer and addition port.
